description: This file implements an integration for Exa AI's search API within a larger search framework. It defines request and response data structures, configuration validation, URL generation, request transformation, and response processing specific to the Exa AI search service.

classes.name: ExaAISearchRequest
classes.description: Data structure for forming requests to the Exa AI search API, inheriting required and optional fields for the API.

classes.name: ExaAISearchConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for setting up and validating the environment for interacting with Exa AI's search API, and transforming request and response data.

methods.name: Dict validate_environment( self, headers: Dict, api_key: Optional[str] = None, api_base: Optional[str] = None, **kwargs, )
methods.description: Validates environment variables and prepares headers for API requests, including retrieving the API key.

methods.name: str get_complete_url( self, api_base: Optional[str], optional_params: dict, data: Optional[Union[Dict, List[Dict]]] = None, **kwargs, )
methods.description: Constructs the full URL for the search endpoint, appending '/search' if necessary.

methods.name: Dict transform_search_request( self, query: Union[str, List[str]], optional_params: dict, **kwargs, )
methods.description: Converts a unified search query and parameters into the specific format required by the Exa AI API.

methods.name: SearchResponse transform_search_response( self, raw_response: httpx.Response, logging_obj: LiteLLMLoggingObj, **kwargs, )
methods.description: Transforms raw HTTP responses from Exa AI into a standardized SearchResponse format used by the broader system.

methods.name: str ui_friendly_name()
methods.description: Returns a user-friendly name for the search provider, 'Exa AI'.

ctags.signature: ( self, query: Union[str, List[str]], optional_params: dict, **kwargs, )
